Edith Wharton, Hudson River Bracketed.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edith-wharton/hudson-river-bracketed

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edith Wharton, the author, died 1937.

First publication of the text used: 1929 (SE colophon: 'Hudson River Bracketed was published in 1929 by Edith Wharton.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1929, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa, and each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1937, so the text is public domain in each of these countries from 1 January 2008 at the latest.
